name: 国际标准大气（ISA）温度计算器

map.由海拔高度按 ISA 模型求气温：对流层（≤11km）每千米降 6.5℃，平流层: Find the air temperature from altitude using the ISA model: in the troposphere (≤11 km) it drops 6.5°C per kilometer, and the base of the stratosphere is isothermal.
map.海平标准温 15℃，11km 处约 −56.5℃ 为对流层顶。: Sea-level standard temperature 15°C; at 11 km it is about −56.5°C, the tropopause.
map.按高度算 ISA 标准气温（对流层 6.5°C/km 递减）。: Compute the ISA standard temperature by altitude (troposphere lapse rate 6.5°C/km).
map.航空性能换算到标准大气参照。: Convert aviation performance to the standard atmosphere reference.
map.海拔 5.5 km：标准气温=15−6.5×5.5=15−35.75=−20.7: Altitude 5.5 km: standard temperature = 15−6.5×5.5 = 15−35.75 = −20.75°C; if the actual is warmer, the density altitude is higher and engine thrust drops.
map.10000 ft：T=15−1.98×10=−4.8°C（1.98°C/1000: 10000 ft: T=15−1.98×10=−4.8°C (1.98°C/1000 ft, i.e. 6.5°C/km); the base of the stratosphere at 11 km is constantly −56.5°C.
map.ISA 是真实大气吗？: Is the ISA the real atmosphere?
map.不是，是海压 1013.25 hPa、15°C 的海平面标准模型，真实大气有偏差: No, it is a sea-level standard model with a sea-level pressure of 1013.25 hPa and 15°C; the real atmosphere deviates and requires corrections.
map.飞机性能看空气密度而非几何高度，热偏差使密度高度高于标高，影响起飞滑跑。: Aircraft performance depends on air density rather than geometric altitude; a warm deviation makes the density altitude higher than the indicated altitude, affecting takeoff roll.
map.温度适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Temperature suitable for?
map.国际标准大气（ISA）对流层温度 T=288.15−6.5·h（h 为海拔 km: International Standard Atmosphere (ISA) troposphere temperature T=288.15−6.5·h (h is altitude in km, in K), i.e. about 6.5°C per 1 km rise.
map.结果可显示 K 或 ℃；公式仅适用于对流层（海拔 ≤ 11 km）。平流层（11: The result can be shown in K or °C; the formula applies only to the troposphere (altitude ≤ 11 km). The stratosphere (11-20 km) is essentially isothermal at about 216.65 K.
map.ISA 为平均标准模型；实际大气随纬度/季节/天气明显偏离，航空/气象请以实测为: The ISA is an average standard model; the real atmosphere deviates noticeably with latitude/season/weather, so for aviation/meteorology rely on measurements.
